title: Bounded compactified site comparison commutes with open restriction
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to S$ have a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}S$ between Noetherian schemes, where $j$ is open and $r$ is proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-pc-scheme]. Work in the bounded-below ordinary derived categories of $A$-module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $R f_!^{\mathrm{et}}=Rr_*^{\mathrm{et}}Dj_!^{\mathrm{et}}$ be the candidate of [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $R f_!^{\mathrm{pro},c}=Rr_*^{\mathrm{pro}}Dj_!^{\mathrm{pro}}$ the corresponding chosen-compactification expression [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. For $L\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the composite of the canonical open-extension and proper direct-image site comparisons is an isomorphism
$$J_{c,L}:\nu_S^*R f_!^{\mathrm{et}}L\xrightarrow{\sim}R f_!^{\mathrm{pro},c}\nu_X^*L.$$
For every open $u:U\hookrightarrow S$, put $X_U=X\times_SU$, $v:X_U\hookrightarrow X$, and let $c_U$ be the restricted compactification. Let $C^{\mathrm{et}}:u^*Rr_*^{\mathrm{et}}Dj_!^{\mathrm{et}}\to Rr_{U*}^{\mathrm{et}}Dj_{U!}^{\mathrm{et}}v^*$ be the canonical compactified open-restriction exchange: the proper exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] for the cartesian square of $r$ over $u$, followed by $Rr_{U*}$ of the inverse of the open-extension comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map]. Let $C^{\mathrm{pro}}$ be the composite given by the same two mate constructions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] on the pro-etale sites. The actual comparison maps satisfy
$$C^{\mathrm{pro}}\circ u_{\mathrm{pro}}^*J_{c,L}=J_{c_U,v^*L}\circ\nu_U^*C^{\mathrm{et}},$$
under the canonical inverse-image comparisons. This equation is natural in $L$ and holds with the canonical direct-image counits and extension-by-zero evaluation counits. It makes no comparison assertion for arbitrary unbounded pro-etale inputs.
